{{Quote|Here you see the suspected pirate vessel, ''GrimDeath I'', a totally converted Old Republic ''Victory''-class warship. It doesn't have the firepower of an Imperial Star Destroyer, but it is impressive nonetheless.|Sergeant Clayton Balrog during his briefing of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT|<ref name="Briefing" />}}
The '''''GrimDeath I''''' was a converted [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]], used as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] vessel during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It staged raids in the [[Woldona system/Legends|Woldona system]] before heading to [[Galpos II/Legends|Galpos II]], and was suspected to be linked with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT]] was tasked with capturing the ship.

==Description==
{{Quote|Remember, there are more than 300 pirates aboard.|Sergeant Clayton Balrog|<ref name="Briefing" />}}
A [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Briefing" /> manufactured by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]],<ref name="SWS" /> the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] which could be known as the ''GrimDeath I'' originally served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ship had been totally converted and refitted as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship, and required only a crew of just over three hundred to operate. It was equipped with [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]], and was armed, but not as well as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Briefing" />

==History==
{{Quote|This vessel is responsible for raids throughout the Woldona System, and recent observations indicate that the pirates in question may have ties to the Rebellion.|Sergeant Clayton Balrog|<ref name="Briefing" />}}
The vessel which would later be named the ''GrimDeath I'' initially served the Galactic Republic as a [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the vessel was in the hands of pirates, and [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] believed that the pirates were in league with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. After conducting a series of raids in the [[Woldona system/Legends|Woldona system]], the ''GrimDeath I'' headed for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galpos II/Legends|Galpos II]]. A [[Unidentified Star Destroyer (Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT)|Star Destroyer]] tracked the vessel, waiting for the [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] and ''[[Terminator/Legends|Terminator]]'' to move in, but Imperial High Command authorized the vessel to engage the ''GrimDeath I'' as they feared the pirates might escape. The plan was for the Star Destroyer to act as a distraction; by entering the ''GrimDeath I''{{'s}} [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] range and forcing the pirate ship to turn and scan the Star Destroyer, a battle [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] carrying [[Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT]] would approach the ''GrimDeath I'' under cover of its engine noise. [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s, led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Clayton Balrog]], would then storm the ship and capture it.<ref name="Briefing" />
